test_crop.note: crop = aligned[y:y+768, x:x+768]; landmarks minus offset; uniform over feasible range per image

test_use.all_10000: headline: every detector at L=100 (both regimes) and curve (a)
test_use.subset_1000: curve (b) draws with L<100, extra ablations, insight ablations, secondary regression

labels.note: left/right = image left/right; point sets are averaged

curve_a.test: draw 0 of each U on all 10000; other draws on the 1000 subset
curve_a.allpairs: ours approximate at U>=300 (all draws), exact at U<=100; hog/dino exact everywhere

budgets.headline_rule: report full curve; abstract quotes largest U and smallest U within 0.02 of it

method.similarity: exact all-pairs up to U=300; 511 approximate at 1000/3000 after validation vs exact at 300
method.clustering: average linkage, one sample per face, stop at p99 of cross-face similarity

primary.name: PCK of one named detector per point (argmax, no correction)
primary.naming: most L faces with argmax within 0.25 IOD; tie -> smaller median distance
primary.also: part group (label-free calibrated sum of detectors named for the point)

secondary.name: NME (% interocular) via ridge regression from detector argmax coords (/1024) to targets, trained on L faces

revised: 2026-09-28 before any run: (1) primary metric = per-part localisation (named detector, PCK), regression NME secondary; (2) comparison = detector swap with the pipeline fixed, two template regimes; (3) test = all 10000 validation (primary), 1000 subset (secondary); extension/headline rules; insight ablations; cost measurements; (4) HMAX two variants; approximation criterion; (5) HMAX variant 1 = S1 filters in our node (not C1: no double pooling); (6) test = 768x768 random same-scale crops (position-only 0.99 -> 0.29 at PCK@0.25); (7) approximation validated at U=100, used at U>=300 for node detectors; U=3000 deferred; (8) curve (b) and ablations on the 1000 subset, headline on all 10000; (9) approximation check at U=300 as equivalence test, margin 2 points; (10) curve (a): ours/dino/hog, draws 10/10/5/5/1, draw 0 on 10k and others on subset, approximation at U>=300 regardless of the check

detectors.ours: 518 node C, 475 minimal box, PCA 64/level from first 8 of U, floor from first 100 of U
detectors.hog: Dalal-Triggs, 9 unsigned bins, 8px cells at 1/4 res, 2x2 blocks L2-Hys, 4x4-block window (160px), dense every 8px
detectors.dino: ViT-S/8 official weights, 512px input, block-11 key facet, token every 16px (reference, pretrained)
detectors.fixed_pipeline: same sigma-32 keypoints; +-16px translation search; argmax-aligned mean templates (3 passes); argmax detection in the same valid area

variants.s1_filters_in_our_node: Gabor 4 orientations (even phase, abs) at each of our 5 pyramid levels, size matched to our sigma 1, replacing gradient+LoG; our boxes/pooling/normalisation/PCA/node unchanged
variants.c1_window_templates: Serre 2007 standard C1 (Gabor 4 orientations, 16 sizes in 8 bands, local max over position and band) + C1 patch window descriptor, cosine, fixed pipeline

detectors.dino_test_input: test crops resized 768 -> 384 px (same scale as 1024 -> 512 for training), token every 16 px

regimes.clustering: regime 1: all-pairs on U, average linkage one-per-face at p99, null min cluster size, named with L
regimes.few_shot: regime 2: aligned mean of descriptors at the labelled positions on the L faces, per instance

cost_measurements: wall time per stage on GTX 1080 Ti

approx_allpairs_criterion.history: U=100 check (|diff|<=0.01) failed: exact 0.717, approx 0.734; U=300 exact for node detectors
approx_allpairs_criterion.check: U=300 draw 0, ours regime-1 named detectors at L=100 (curve-b draw), PCK@0.25 per crop mean of 6 points, 1000-image subset; paired bootstrap 95% CI of approx-exact (1000 resamples, seed 0) within [-0.02, 0.02]
approx_allpairs_criterion.pass_: approximation at U=1000 for node detectors
approx_allpairs_criterion.revision_10: approximation used for ours at U=300 (curve a) and U=1000 regardless; the U=300 equivalence check is reported, not a gate
